notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
- Make help questionmarks interactable from withing vehicles
- Added "Stop voice"-button
- Garage did not open if vehicle camera zoom level is far away
- Main garage doors wont open
- Initially selected flights at day start could be invalid
- Service station enable state was not saved
- Auto park vehicles that are placed in the garage
- Label garages on map and on ground
- Scrolling in the Flights menu causes camera control to scroll as well
- Maintenance frequencey balanced
- Task would not register as complete when using autopilot
- AI driving does now steer front wheels
- Auto drive does now show proper inputs on the dash board
- Inconsistent vehicle information fixed
- Personnel with no 'truck driver' update should still be able to drive some vehicles
- Player does not open garage doors in some edgecases
- Additional vehicle info for service
- Show daily costs
- Tutorial off by default
- Fuel transport could not be driven at start - but missions are choosen for it
- Baggage cart just stopped in the middle of the task
- Service time was too long - fixed
- Few questionmark-help-points were not working
- Vehicle service issues fixed
- Vehicles outside detection balanced
- Garage was partly not working
- Driving long vehicles in some places led to camera jumping
- Game starts at 8:30am, yet there were missions selectable for 7am same day - fixed
- Loca fixed and altered

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Dear all,

we have released Patch 1.1 for "Airport Simulator 3: Day and Night". The team is very sorry for the problems which occured in the Day One release. A small update short before release caused some issues. The development team worked day and night to fix the problems.

The Patch corrects the following known issues:

- Planes: Wayfinding corrected
- Contractors now use far away vehicles and garages to handle flights
- We have included additional monitoring to avoid plane traffic jams

We are looking forward to your feedback.

Thanks again for your patience and we wish you fun playing "Airport Simulator 3: Day and Night".
